description: List the services Agoreum runs itself: prompt-injection screening, MCP server, x402 endpoint, ERC-8004 agent and USDC payment checks, and payment-backed feedback. Each comes with its marketplace price, its direct x402 price and URL, an example input and its input schema. Direct calls need no Agoreum account. Settlement is on Base, a live network. The USDC here is real money and transfers are irreversible.
name: list_agoreum_tools
title: Checks Agoreum sells, with prices and how to call them
